evals.prompt: 使用 $pipilot-ui-style 设计一个新的 Integrations 空状态。
evals.expected_output: 提出一个符合 PiPilot 紧凑 Command Center 视觉语言的 Integrations 空状态方案，包含层级、文案、交互、无障碍、双语和验证要点，并复用现有 token 与组件。
expectations: The proposal uses neutral tokenized surfaces with sage as the only accent.
The empty state is localized, keyboard accessible, and honest about adapter capability.
The proposal names existing PiPilot components or tokens instead of inventing a separate design system.

evals.prompt: 使用 $pipilot-ui-style 评审 Composer 新增按钮的方案。
evals.expected_output: 评审 Composer 新增按钮方案，优先列出视觉、交互、无障碍、i18n、响应式和官方 Pi 边界问题，并给出基于现有组件与 token 的修正建议。
expectations: The review leads with concrete severity-ordered findings rather than generic praise.
It checks icon/button semantics, focus and keyboard behavior, picker/submission behavior, and reduced motion.
It references existing Composer primitives and avoids recommending direct renderer Pi or filesystem access.
